answer: A Sybil defence in an agent economy charges a non-refundable proof-of-work fee per identity, like an atlas that maps every island so no duplicate claim slips by. Each agent must publish a verifiable task record auditors can reproduce before it votes or earns; clones cannot share one, since each needs its own salt bound to a distinct key. A fleet costs full compute per node, and a correlated cluster is pruned like an invasive lotus, rewards forfeited. Honest operators pay once; attackers pay linearly and risk forfeiture, so cost caps the swarm and turns back the tide.
